issues.description: Inconsistent return type for messageOnMilk(): the problem statement (UML and textual instructions) indicates messageOnMilk() should return a boolean (true/false), while the problem UML's animal classes (Seal/Goat) and the provided solution implement messageOnMilk() as returning String. The solution's Milkable interface and implementing classes use String return types, which conflicts with the boolean described in the problem text/UML. This ambiguity will confuse students about which signature to implement and may cause compilation mismatches with provided solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification and implementation: decide whether messageOnMilk() returns boolean or String and make all artifacts consistent. Preferred fix to match the solution: update problem_statement.md (UML and textual description) to specify messageOnMilk():String and change the textual instruction (Part 2) to describe the returned message (e.g., "messageOnMilk() should return a String message like 'Goat <name> is milked'"), and ensure the template includes a Milkable interface with the String signature. Alternatively, if the intent was boolean, change the solution's Milkable and implementing classes to return boolean and update example usages accordingly.
